note: Round 7 step 10 usability tasks. The wording, answers and checks are fixed before any session; scripts/usability_summary.py grades the stored boards against `check` and api/tests/test_usability_study.py re-derives every answer from the database. Never edit a task after the first real session: add a new taskSet instead.

tasks.title: Two players side by side
tasks.text: Open the Workbench. Make a table that compares Nikola Jokić and Joel Embiid: their points, rebounds and assists per game in every season from 2020-21 to 2025-26.
tasks.question: In which season did Jokić average the most assists per game?
tasks.hint: Start with a Set: it holds the players. Then add a Table.
tasks.success: A table on the board shows both players' points, rebounds and assists per game, one row per season, 2020-21 to 2025-26; and the answer is 2025-26 (10.7 a game).

tasks.title: Find players, then plot them
tasks.text: Find every player who, in a season from 2022-23 on, averaged at least 20 points a game on at least 60% true shooting (in at least 40 games). Put them on your board and draw a chart of their usage against their true shooting.
tasks.hint: The Finder block searches by conditions; its results can go into a set, and a Chart can use that set.
tasks.success: A scatter chart with usage % and true shooting % on its axes, drawn for a set that holds the players the search finds (42 players, 80 player-seasons).

tasks.title: Count big games
tasks.text: In the 2025-26 regular season, in how many games did Shai Gilgeous-Alexander score 40 points or more?
tasks.question: How many games?
tasks.hint: Game-by-game numbers are in the player games data, in a Table or in the Finder.
tasks.success: The answer 8 (of his 68 games), found on the Workbench by any route.

tasks.title: One of the app's tools
tasks.text: Add Stephen Curry's shot chart from his 2015-16 season to your board.
tasks.hint: The app's own tools (shot chart, game log…) are under App tool; they show one player of a set.
tasks.success: A shot chart block on the board showing Curry, season 2015-16.

tasks.title: Send it to someone
tasks.text: You want a friend to see your board. Get something you could send them in a chat or by email.
tasks.hint: Look at the buttons next to the board's name.
tasks.success: A share link copied, or the board exported as a file (a board too big for a link says so and points to the file).

tasks.title: Type it in English (optional)
tasks.text: Use the Finder's type-in box to find players who averaged at least 10 rebounds and 10 assists a game in a season, and run the search.
tasks.hint: Add a Finder block; the box at its top takes a sentence.
tasks.success: The sentence filled the Finder's boxes (rebounds ≥ 10 and assists ≥ 10 per game) and Find players was run. Skip this task when the computer is offline or the Gemini key isn't set.
